integrity: All-parameter proof uses quotient rational identities and coefficient positivity; independent exact symbolic and rational test script included. No claim of independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to a weighted star with one anomalous spoke and m>=4; it gives endpoint positivity for every timestep, not stage positivity or arbitrary heterogeneous spokes. The 1998 group-inverse full text was not accessible; literature priority risk remains.
title: Sharp one-spoke defect tolerance for fourth-order Gauss graph-heat integration
